requirement.original: 进一步完善hook彻底永久根本禁止你使用任何途径自己重启，除非我使用allow command
requirement.clarified: Permanently and completely forbid Claude (orchestrator and subagents) from restarting OR otherwise disrupting any happy-daemon-* unit by ANY path: direct systemctl using verbs {stop, restart, disable, enable, reload, kill, try-restart, reload-or-restart}; chained or wrapped invocations; wrapper scripts on disk (/tmp/*.sh); env-shifted or time-shifted execution; dbus signaling to systemd; daemon HTTP /stop on any localhost port; unit-file edits; agent-prompt indirection. The ONLY allowed path is an explicit, time-bounded, single-shot grant created by the user from a real TTY via a CLI command (claude-allow-restart <target>). Hooks must read the grant sentinel atomically and consume it on first match. Generic /allow must NOT bypass this prohibition.
requirement.what: Multi-layer hook hardening + new CLI grant channel that produces a sentinel file the hooks consume
requirement.why: On 2026-05-04 22:16 the orchestrator chained `sudo systemctl restart happy-daemon-dev && echo ok` and it passed every layer of the existing hook stack because happy-daemon-dev is on the dev whitelist (line 35 of /root/.claude/hooks/pretool-bash-safety.sh). The user's new directive is absolute: no self-restart by any path, ever, unless an explicit allow-command is invoked.

allow_command_contract.name: claude-allow-restart
allow_command_contract.owner: user (must run from real TTY; refuses inside Claude session via tty -s check)

positional_target.typo_handling: fail with enumerated-options error message; do NOT silently fall back

--ttl.behavior: values >60 are clamped to 60 with stderr WARN

--list.behavior: print active grants (read all /tmp/claude-allow-daemon-restart-*.flag, validate, print non-expired)

--dry-run.behavior: print intended sentinel JSON without writing

sentinel_format.target: string (one of: dev, default, jade, qijie, all)

allow_command_contract.consumption_semantics: atomic flock+SIGALRM (reuse check_and_consume_allowlist scaffolding from pretool-bash-safety.sh:114-298). On systemctl-match, hook: (1) acquires flock LOCK_EX|LOCK_NB on the sentinel; (2) reads JSON; (3) validates target == bare-unit-suffix, expires_at > now, session_id == current sid; (4) if valid: unlinks atomically, logs outcome=consumed, exit 0; (5) if invalid: exit 2 with appropriate stderr substring. Hook holds flock throughout to prevent concurrent consume.
allow_command_contract.multi_target_behavior: A grant for 'dev' covers ONLY happy-daemon-dev. A grant for 'all' covers any happy-daemon-*. Other unit names are not covered. The hook compares the bare unit name (after stripping .service) to the grant target.
allow_command_contract.revoke_semantics: --revoke <target> unlinks the sentinel immediately AND writes outcome=revoked to audit log. Subsequent Claude attempts on that target re-block.

error_recovery.claude_crashes_after_grant_before_use: TTL ≤60s self-cleans. User can --revoke explicitly if desired before TTL.
error_recovery.claude_crashes_during_consume: flock is process-bound; on hook process exit, flock released; sentinel may or may not be unlinked depending on which step the hook reached. Hook code must unlink BEFORE returning success; if it returned success, the sentinel is gone. If hook crashed mid-write of audit log, sentinel may already be unlinked but audit log entry missing — acceptable degradation (user can correlate via grant timestamp). v1 does not guarantee atomic audit-log + unlink.
error_recovery.two_grants_in_quick_succession: Each --target X invocation overwrites /tmp/claude-allow-daemon-restart-X.flag. v1 does not stack grants; second invocation replaces the first. --list shows current grant only.
